runtime.description: Inferno armies surge from lava citadels with imps, gogs, cerberi, demons, pit fiends, efreet, and devils. Demoniacs and heretics thrive on fire, sacrifice, gated reinforcements, and relentless pressure from creatures born in the underworld.

allowedDebt: Inferno is release-enabled with manifest-owned Core output, unit import rows, bundles, static portraits, preview manifests, lab sidecars, faction art, city billboard art, and dwelling billboard frames present in the source plugin.
The current runtime SID convention expands Familiar/Magog/Cerberus style upgrades as *_upg rows. Original HoMM3 names are preserved as display/search metadata until alias support exists.
Efreeti currently uses the Demon wasp donor shell because release Core has no traced eldritch_flyer/fire-shell donor. Fire immunity, Fire Shield, hate, and caster mechanics remain static-trace debt.

Inferno town card currently uses the Third Upgrades hall background as a temporary source-backed image; the real HoMM3 Inferno town backdrop still needs H3bitmap.lod source verification before release-quality town-screen promotion.

Hell Steed, Nightmare, and Hell Stallion are ToA extra branch rows and are not representable in the current seven-line manifest schema. Keep this as release hardening debt; do not hide Inferno from DB/data.json as a crash workaround.
